title: August and the Thorn
premise: Dominic Kavanagh, a cartographer whose gift for mapping unmapped realms has never worked beyond the valley where magic cannot follow, is conscripted by the crown's witch-hunters when his gift is exposed. Forced to guide the hunt, he secretly protects the gifted people he finds while falling in love with Seren, a huntress who does not know she carries the very gift she's been trained to destroy. When Dominic discovers the valley itself is a seal holding back an ancient war — and that his own blood is the key — he must choose between revealing the truth and keeping it buried. In the end, Dominic sacrifices his memories of Seren to reseal the valley, but she chooses to stay with him anyway, loving him anew as the thirteenth moon rises.
about_author: Jonah Zhou is a former surveyor who spent a decade drawing borders that no one respected before turning to fiction. He writes from a small house at the edge of a valley he refuses to name.

chapters.title: The Valley That Refuses Ink
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. He maps the unmappable from within a valley where magic cannot follow, hiding his gift behind mundane survey work. A routine commission goes wrong when his ink moves on its own, sketching a realm he's never seen. Emotional beat: quiet dread beneath an ordinary life, the first crack in his safety.

chapters.title: Proclamation at the Mill Bridge
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The crown's criers announce the Gifted Hunt: all bearers of magic must be surrendered or burned. Neighbors eye each other; Dominic burns his most dangerous maps. Emotional beat: the valley's innocence curdling into suspicion, duty pressing against self-preservation.

chapters.title: What the Compass Found
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. A royal cartographer's compass spins toward Dominic's workshop; hunters arrive with a warrant. His mother lies to protect him, but a neighbor sells him out. Emotional beat: betrayal by the familiar, the moment home stops being safe.

chapters.title: Iron and Oath
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Bound and interrogated by Captain Vess, Dominic bargains: his gift can find what no hunter can — the hidden enclaves of the gifted. Emotional beat: shame and calculation, choosing survival over principle and hating himself for it.

chapters.title: The Huntress Who Sang Off-Key
chapters.summary: Seren's POV. Introduced on the hunt as Vess's best tracker, Seren notices Dominic flinching at things he shouldn't know. She sings to steady her horses — always off-key, always unbothered. Emotional beat: wry competence masking loneliness; first spark of curiosity about the prisoner.

chapters.title: First Blood on the Map
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. His gift leads the hunt to a real enclave; he tries to warn them subtly, fails, and watches a family flee into the hills. One hunter dies to a warding thorn. Emotional beat: guilt made flesh — his talent is now a weapon.

chapters.title: Thirteenth Moon Rising
chapters.summary: Seren's POV. Seren dreams of a valley sealed in silver and wakes with frost on her fingers — magic she was taught to hate. She confides nothing, but begins watching Dominic differently. Emotional beat: dread of self-discovery, the enemy wearing her own face.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Bargain
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Dominic strikes a secret deal with an enclave elder: false maps in exchange for answers about the valley's seal. He learns his bloodline forged it. Emotional beat: tentative hope, the intoxicating danger of double agency.

chapters.title: Ashes in the Orchard
chapters.summary: Seren's POV. The hunt burns an orchard sheltering gifted children; Seren disobeys orders to save two, and Vess marks her. She and Dominic share a fire, saying everything except the truth. Emotional beat: love kindling inside complicity, tenderness shadowed by what each hides.

chapters.title: The False Map
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Dominic's forged map sends the hunt in circles, but Vess grows suspicious and tests him with a trap route. He barely passes — at the cost of a gifted stranger's capture. Emotional beat: the price of deception paid in someone else's blood.

chapters.title: Frost on Her Hands
chapters.summary: Seren's POV. Seren's magic erupts publicly during a skirmish; only Dominic's quick lie saves her from Vess. Now hunted by her own company, she flees with him. Emotional beat: terror and liberation intertwined — losing everything, gaining an ally.

chapters.title: Roads Not on Any Chart
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. On the run together, Dominic shows Seren how his gift sees the world; she teaches him to fight without magic. They grow close across campfires and narrow escapes. Emotional beat: warmth after pursuit, love taking root in exile.

chapters.title: The Elder's Confession
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The enclave elder reveals the full history: the valley is a seal Dominic's ancestors placed to imprison a war-magic that fed on the gifted. Breaking it reignites the ancient war; the crown's hunt is unknowingly gathering fuel for it. Emotional beat: vertigo of scale — personal stakes revealed as cosmic ones.

chapters.title: Vess Closes the Net
chapters.summary: Seren's POV. Vess, half-suspecting the truth, corners the fugitives using Seren's old habits against her. A brutal chase through the marshes; they escape, but the elder is captured. Emotional beat: grief sharpening resolve, the hunt becoming personal war.

chapters.title: What the Thorn Remembers
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Guided by his moving ink, Dominic reaches the heart of the valley and touches the seal-thorn, which floods him with ancestral memory — including a vision of a future where Seren dies if the seal breaks. Emotional beat: awe curdled into foreknowledge, love now carrying a death sentence.

chapters.title: The Interrogation of the Elder
chapters.summary: Seren's POV. Captured and questioned, the elder gives Vess just enough truth to make the hunt a crusade: break the seal, harvest the war-magic, win the crown's wars forever. Vess marches on the valley. Emotional beat: horror at how noble intentions are weaponized.

chapters.title: Two Traitors, One Road Back
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Dominic and Seren race home ahead of the army, warning scattered enclaves along the way. They confess their secrets to each other fully — his bargain, her past hunts — and choose each other anyway. Emotional beat: honesty as sanctuary, love confirmed under worst light.

chapters.title: The Siege of the Quiet Valley
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Vess's forces breach the valley as the twelfth moon sets. Dominic fights beside the people he once betrayed, his maps turned to weapons, buying time until the thirteenth turn. Emotional beat: redemption earned in fire, home defended by its prodigal son.

chapters.title: Thirteenth Turn
chapters.summary: Seren's POV. At the seal, Vess forces a confrontation; Seren turns her own gift against the captain, mortally wounded in the process. The seal cracks as the moon completes its turn. Emotional beat: sacrifice at the threshold, love and duty colliding at last.

chapters.title: The Price of the Seal
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. To reseal the valley, the thorn demands a memory of equal weight to the war-magic's pull. Dominic feeds it every memory of Seren, closing the rift as she watches, unable to stop him. Emotional beat: devastating choice — saving the world by erasing the reason he wanted to save it.

chapters.title: A Stranger at My Door
chapters.summary: Seren's POV. Healing slowly, Seren returns to find Dominic alive but blank toward her — courteous, empty, gone. She stays anyway, telling herself stories of who they were. Emotional beat: grief without a grave, love outliving its witness.

chapters.title: August and the Thorn
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. In August, a year later, the thorn blooms early — and releases one memory back as interest: their first meeting at the mill bridge. Dominic doesn't understand why he weeps, but asks Seren to tell him more. Emotional beat: hope as slow thaw; not a restoration, but a beginning.
